rules.label: Defeated ally within Reach (Not On My Watch: +1 Toughness/Evasion)
Ally Defeated: Move toward them (Not On My Watch)

steps.label: Move toward them (Not On My Watch)
steps.intro: An ally dropped to 0 Health: an extra Move toward them.

steps.text: {name} rushes up to {@actor.system.movement.ground.total} ft toward their fallen teammate.

rules.label: Ally Defeated by Stun: Move toward them (Not On My Watch)

steps.label: Move toward them (Not On My Watch)
steps.intro: An ally was Defeated by Stun: an extra Move toward them.

steps.text: {name} rushes up to {@actor.system.movement.ground.total} ft toward their fallen teammate.

automation.notes: Automatic: +1 Toughness and Evasion while a Defeated teammate is within your reach. Chat card: when an ally is Defeated (Health at 0, or Stun reaching their Health), you get a button that grants you an extra Move.

source.book: Factions in Action Vol 2: Intercontinental Adventures
